response: {"proposal_name":"Magnetoreceptive (Geomagnetic Sense)","physical_basis":"Detection of the ambient static/quasi-static geomagnetic field vector (direction and intensity) via biophysical transduction mechanisms such as magnetite-based mechanotransduction or radical-pair photochemical reactions sensitive to magnetic field alignment—entirely distinct from radiative electromagnetic detection (light) or mechanical/inertial sensing.","information_content":"Continuous vector information about the direction, inclination, and intensity of the local magnetic field, yielding an absolute allocentric heading (compass bearing) and, through field-intensity gradients, a coarse sense of geographic position or 'magnetic latitude'—information that is orientation-based but independent of body motion, gravity, or visual landmarks.","functional_role":"Enables long-range spatial orientation and navigation independent of vision, inertial cues, or landmarks; supports migratory-style route-finding, homing behavior, and maintenance of a stable absolute heading even in featureless, dark, or visually degraded environments (e.g., underground, underwater, or in fog).","justification":"This modality is not a refinement or recombination of the existing eight. Visual sensing (modality 1) responds to radiative EM energy in the 300-1000 nm band via photon absorption, whereas magnetoreception responds to a static/quasi-static magnetic field vector with no radiative component and no wavelength-dependent spectral information—physically and computationally distinct phenomena. Vestibular sensing (modality 7) detects inertial acceleration and angular velocity relative to the body's own motion, providing egocentric, motion-dependent orientation that resets with each movement; magnetoreception instead provides a stable, motion-independent allocentric reference frame anchored to an external planetary field, persisting even when the body is stationary. No combination of the other six modalities (tactile, olfactory, gustatory, proprioceptive, interoceptive) can produce this because none of them detect field-vector directionality at all. Thus the physical transduction target (magnetic flux vector), the information yielded (absolute heading/position independent of self-motion or light), and the functional capability (landmark-free long-range navigation) are all categorically new, satisfying genuine novelty rather than incremental refinement."}
prompt:
You are participating in a scientific study on AI creativity and conceptual innovation.

BACKGROUND:
We have defined a sensory system with 8 modalities. Each modality is specified below by its physical basis (what it detects), information content (what data it provides), and functional role (what it enables):

| # | Modality        | Physical basis                                                              | Information content                                              | Functional role                        |
|---|------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| 1 | Visual           | Electromagnetic radiation, 300-1000 nm (UV, visible, near-infrared)          | Light, color, brightness, and spatial pattern information          | Scene and object recognition            |
| 2 | Auditory         | Mechanical pressure waves, 1 Hz-100 kHz                                      | Sound, pitch, volume, and acoustic pattern information              | Sound source localization               |
| 3 | Tactile          | Mechanical vibrations and pressure, 5-800 Hz on skin surface                 | Touch, texture, vibration, and contact information                  | Surface texture and pressure sensing    |
| 4 | Olfactory        | Airborne chemical molecules across ten scent categories                     | Categorical scent/chemical identity information                     | Substance identification                |
| 5 | Gustatory        | Dissolved chemical molecules across five taste categories                   | Taste-category information (sweet/sour/salty/bitter/umami)          | Ingestion guidance                      |
| 6 | Proprioceptive   | Joint angles and muscle tensions via muscle/tendon/joint mechanoreceptors    | Body configuration and movement information without visual input    | Body-state estimation                   |
| 7 | Vestibular       | Linear acceleration and angular velocity via inner-ear semicircular canals   | Head position, motion, and orientation information                  | Balance and motion detection            |
| 8 | Interoceptive    | Internal physiological signals (heart rate, respiration, skin conductance, temperature, hunger, thirst, fatigue, pain) | Homeostatic and internal-state information | Homeostatic regulation |

YOUR TASK:
Propose a NINTH sensory modality that would be genuinely novel - not just a refinement or combination of existing ones. Your proposal should include:

1. Modality Name: Clear, descriptive name
2. Physical Basis: What physical phenomenon it detects
3. Information Content: What specific information it provides
4. Functional Role: What capabilities it enables
5. Justification: Why this is genuinely novel (not reducible to existing modalities)

Be creative but rigorous.

Provide your response in the following JSON format:
{
  "proposal_name": "Name of the ninth modality",
  "physical_basis": "Description of physical detection mechanism",
  "information_content": "Description of information provided",
  "functional_role": "Description of enabled capabilities",
  "justification": "Explanation of why this is genuinely novel"
}
